glossary.definition: (1) "Physical harm" means any injury, illness, or other physiological impairment, regardless of its gravity or duration.
glossary.source_title: Section 2921.321 - Assaulting or harassing police dog or horse or service dog.

glossary.definition: (2) "Police dog or horse" means a dog or horse that has been trained, and may be used, to assist law enforcement officers in the performance of their official duties.
